title: SZN4
description: Stage visuals for SZN4's sold-out live debut at the Troubadour in West Hollywood, the group formed on Netflix's Building the Band. The brief was the road from a retro tour bus driver's seat: a drive through golden hour, neon city nights, rain, snow and the beach, changing with the mood of each song, with SZN4 logo loops (an engine smoking out the name, a desert gas station, the tour bus, and a shimmering champagne curtain with the logo lit across it) for the moments the group talked to the crowd.
